Container.Name: Nuvio Manager
Container.Overview: Nuvio Manager is a remote management web app for Nuvio TV. It manages catalog order, visibility, titles and addons across multiple managed accounts. No data is stored on the server; accounts are kept in the browser.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Nuvio Manager web interface.

Config.Name: Supabase URL
Config.Description: Default Supabase API URL pre-filled when adding an account. Leave as is for official Nuvio.

Config.Name: Supabase anon key
Config.Description: Default Supabase anon (public) key pre-filled when adding an account. It can also be entered per account in the app.
